sponsor: Explicit paid external sponsorship or advertising read.
selfpromo: Creator's own paid product, membership, merchandise, course or service. Separate optional category.
neutral: Ordinary reviews and unpaid product discussion; like/subscribe requests.
uncertain: Affiliate-only or gifted products without clear paid read; conflicting crowd labels or unclear compensation. Require human review.
negativeEvidence: Only explicitly reviewed intervals count as verified ordinary content. No crowd submission is unknown.
pilotLabelQuality: SponsorBlock provisional, partial, unreviewed. No cloud labeling.
captionBoundary: Native caption cue endpoints retained. Specialist word/character timestamps interpolate within cues, with explicit approximation.
review: All candidates use the same versioned reviewed references; queue includes disagreements, unknown predictions, suspicious boundaries and negative cases.
